a03_f00e: Very shortly, all of us, young and old,
will pledge allegiance to our new leader, Soviet Premier Romanov...
Commander,
your performance in Colorado was damned impressive.
But while you were out fighting, things changed. The war is over.
I have come to understand that the Communists want the same things we do...
I do not think we should hear any more of that.
The President, and even General Carville, appear to be under the influence of a Soviet Psychic Beacon.
The Psychic Beacon is a mind-control device developed by this man.
His name is Yuri.
Our sources have finally confirmed that Yuri and his psychic forces
were chiefly responsible for breaking down our defenses before the invasion.
The Soviets now control many of the people in this area.
Oh, do not worry, Commander.
I have not turned Red yet!
Intelligence has not confirmed the precise location of the Psychic Beacon,
but we know it will be heavily guarded by Soviet forces.
I can put you in touch with troops in the area who have not been affected.
Use those forces to destroy the Psychic Beacon.
Once it is destroyed, we can evacuate the President to safety.
a03_p01e: Commander, whatever we are paying you, I do not think it is enough.
I do not know how you got us out of that mess, but I am grateful.
When this is all over, I intend to promote you to... uh...
whatever position you want. Except President, of course.
Stay alert, Commander. I need you.
